in_marathi.name: Dhaarani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Support, Upholder, Protector

It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of strength and stability. In Hindu mythology, Dhaarani is the name of a goddess who is the embodiment of strength and resilience. She is often depicted as a powerful warrior who protects her followers and upholds righteousness.
